title: Business Card — Front + Back

BACK: same card with the white 'ONGEA PESA' wordmark top-left, then placeholder contact lines 'Name · Role', 'hello@ongeapesa.com', 'ongeapesa.com', and at the bottom a small 'by Nairobi Space of AI Tools · NSAIT' with NSAIT in a violet-to-blue gradient (#6D28D9 to #2563EB).
